title: 🚩 Kind of People You Find in CBTL Islamabad Part 1
body: A man who has ordered nothing but an iced caramel latte for two years and still calls himself a coffee person. Cigarette smoke drifting over from three tables like it's part of the menu. A guy circling the outdoor seating twice before picking the table closest to the prettiest girl there, opening line already rehearsed in the car. A Lexus 570 parked at an angle that eats two spaces, its owner twice the age of every girl he's making eye contact with. A group of girls fully aware they're being looked at, adjusting nothing, because the attention was already accounted for before they left the house.
caption:
Tag the sugar daddy who thinks the Lexus is doing the talking for him 😭
